svg.title: Lulu’s current justurban wears order checklist
svg.desc: Nine-step manual operator checklist. WhatsApp is the customer conversation and Studio is a separate device-local stock lifecycle; they are not synchronized.
svg.text: WhatsApp is the customer conversation. Studio records separate local stock changes.

g.text: Opening WhatsApp is not enough. Start only when the
customer’s sent message appears in Lulu’s WhatsApp.
Check the reference, SKU, size, total, contact, and handoff.
Match the message to the listing and physical piece.
Select Reserve sale on the matching published listing.
This creates a separate, device-local stock order.
Confirm availability, amount, account, reference, and timing.
Send the instructions manually in WhatsApp.
Check the real account and amount—not only a screenshot.
Acknowledge the verified payment in WhatsApp.
Inspect the condition, complete approved preparation,
and pack the exact piece securely for handoff.
Dispatch and share delivery details, or agree a clear
Message payment, readiness, dispatch, or pickup changes.
Studio actions do not notify the customer.
Mark sold at the defined completion point. For a return,
inspect and choose Restock to review or Write off.
WhatsApp does not create a Studio order. Studio actions do not send messages or prove delivery.
Cancellation release is not available in Studio today.
